mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a guest bathroom remodel in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a guest bathroom remodel can vary significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and existing conditions. Minor updates like painting, new fixtures, and a vanity can start lower, while a complete gut renovation with custom tile, new plumbing, and high-end finishes will be considerably more. For homeowners in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville, Hometelligent Inc. can provide a detailed estimate after an initial consultation to assess your specific project needs and preferences.
